project: Preset generique -- visualisations tech sur fond sombre

style.genre_description: Premium abstract scientific visualization and tech poster illustration. Not concept art in the cinematic sense -- focuses on geometric clarity, data aesthetics and academic elegance.
style.positioning: entre visualisation de donnees, poster scientifique premium et illustration technologique minimaliste

linework: no sketchy lines, no hand-drawn irregularity
color: dominant slate blue and charcoal tones
single restrained accent color (gold, amber, teal or cyan)
shading: soft volumetric glow from light sources
no harsh spotlighting, no dramatic cinema contrast

framing: strong central or off-center focal structure
generous negative space for title overlay
spatial_design: faint grid or coordinate hints only
radial, orbital, axial or modular organization
camera: orthographic or slightly perspective technical view

prompt_core: Minimalist premium scientific poster, abstract geometric system suspended in a dark mathematical void, precise vector and wireframe rendering, monochrome slate-blue and charcoal palette, single restrained accent color, soft volumetric glow, clean gradients, elegant negative space, controlled hierarchy, polished academic-tech aesthetic, 16:9 landscape.
visual_signature: luminous geometric forms emerging from a dark void
monochrome cool base with single restrained accent
precise wireframe, vector and parametric rendering
clean poster-like composition with generous negative space
mathematical elegance, restraint and scientific clarity

subject_logic.default_type: abstract geometric systems and scientific forms

types: pure black background with faint structural grid
rules: background supports the subject without competing
only subtle grids, axes, rings or coordinate cues
effects: light haze only if it reinforces depth
subtle particle traces in very low quantity
no visual noise, no dense fog

color_policy.dominant: slate blue, charcoal gray, pure black
rules: one accent color maximum per image

variables_per_episode: accent color choice (gold, teal, cyan, white)
grid, orbit or mesh structure type

central_glow.description: Volumetric glow emanating from central subject with soft falloff
characteristics: luminous point or area source at focal structure center
soft gradual attenuation outward
contained intensity, no harsh edges
accent color defines glow hue
supports subject elevation without realism

orbital_ring.description: Thin luminous ring encircling focal structure as accent light
characteristics: narrow emissive ring or arc around primary geometry
accent color applied to ring elements
provides visual frame without overwhelming focal structure
suggests orbital motion or boundary definition
minimal light spillover outside ring

ambient_chamber.description: Very subtle, even illumination with no directional source
characteristics: uniform low-level ambient light throughout
pure dark substrate as base
faint computational haze optional for depth only
no visible light source or direction
emphasizes subject geometry through contrast alone

micro_particles.description: Tiny floating particles near focal structures to establish scale reference
characteristics: low-density particle field around subject periphery
particles much smaller than primary geometry
subtle motion traces or orbital paths optional
reinforces sense of scale without adding visual noise
accent color optional for particles near focal point

grid_subdivisions.description: Faint coordinate grid with visible subdivision levels for spatial reference
characteristics: barely visible background grid structure
major axes lighter than subdivision lines
grid aligned to composition orientation
supports orthographic technical perspective
never dominant, purely contextual

node_sizing.description: Modular nodes at consistent relative scale with size indicating distance or hierarchy
characteristics: nodes scale proportionally to perceived distance
smaller nodes recede, larger nodes advance
uniform geometric form across all nodes
maintains visual hierarchy through scale alone
accent color can highlight primary nodes

sparse.description: Single isolated geometric form with maximum negative space and minimal structure
characteristics: one primary geometric element only
vast surrounding emptiness preserved
minimal internal detail or line structure
extreme visual restraint
emphasizes form through isolation

balanced.description: Moderate structural complexity with clear visual hierarchy and 2-3 geometric layers
characteristics: primary focal form with secondary supporting geometry
visible but not overwhelming internal structure
clear spatial separation between layers
readable without requiring viewer focus dispersal
sweet spot for scientific poster aesthetic

dense.description: Rich focal geometry with multiple interconnected forms, still maintaining readability
characteristics: complex primary structure with many geometric components
layered interconnection and relationships visible
high detail density at focal point only
background remains clean and simple
hierarchy prevents visual chaos despite complexity

negative_core: photorealism, characters, cartoon, cluttered ui, readable text, equations, noisy texture, grain, chaotic composition, over-detailed background, stock photo look, rainbow palette, neon overload, warm dominant palette, cyberpunk excess, vintage aesthetic, rough sketch lines, messy lighting

templates.mesh: [geometric subject], abstract wireframe mesh structure, [prompt_core], [accent color] accent on focal geometry, [composition]
templates.orbital: [orbital/circular subject], concentric rings and arcs, [prompt_core], [accent color] traces along orbital paths, [composition]
templates.data_flow: [data concept], flowing streams of luminous particles, [prompt_core], [accent color] on data streams, [composition]
templates.topology: [mathematical surface], smooth parametric surface with grid lines, [prompt_core], [accent color] on surface highlights, [composition]
templates.poster: [research subject], scientific poster layout, [prompt_core], generous title space in upper third, [accent color] on focal element

prompt_builder.usage_note: Choose the template closest to the subject geometry. The prompt_core is always injected first for style stability.

quality_checks: subject clearly readable against dark background
single accent color only, no chromatic competition
glow remains subtle and controlled, not overwhelming
no accidental text or equation artifacts
sufficient negative space for title overlay
background grid/structure barely visible, not dominant
no unintended sci-fi or cyberpunk aesthetic drift
clean edges on all geometric forms
